newsitem.title: USA: Royce sees Q4 break-even or loss, 97 profit.
newsitem.headline: Royce sees Q4 break-even or loss, 97 profit.

text.p: Royce Laboratories Inc said on Thursday that it is expecting a break-even or slight loss for the fourth quarter but is optimistic it will achieve a profit in 1997.

On Thursday the company reported third quarter sales of $5.8 million, compared to $2.4 million in the third quarter 1995. Net income was $118,000 or $0.01 per share, compared to a year-ago loss of $766,000 or $0.06 per share, the company said.

The company said it expects fourth quarter revenues to approximate those of the third quarter, resulting in about $23 million in revenues for the full year, or a 119 percent increase over 1995 revenues of $10.5 million.
"The company is optimistic about its outlook and that while it is not yet in a position to estimate its 1997 earnings, it expects to be profitable in 1997," the company stated.
